overview:
New Mexico's 1st District leans Democratic by seven points, and incumbent Melanie Stansbury is seeking reelection with every structural advantage in place. She has raised more than $1.3 million and holds over $400,000 in cash, with modest outside support, while Republican Didi Okpareke has raised about $100,000 and lacks outside backing. Prediction markets give Democrats roughly a 96 percent chance of holding the seat.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the lopsided financial picture, all of which align. The expected margin is near twenty points, placing the contest firmly in the Safe Democratic category. With the incumbent renominated and heavily funded in a district that favors her party, the available evidence points to an easy general election.
